_comment: FROZEN realizable-exit outcome-realism constants. DO NOT EDIT (retune) after the first
realizable edge-proof run. This is the audit-parity twin of MOMENTUM_PARAMS.frozen.json and
baseline.frozen.json: it externalizes the realizable-exit model's constants so they are a
declared, change-controlled artifact rather than magic numbers buried in code (anti-p-hacking).
The canonical hash in `frozen_hash` is recomputed deterministically from `params` alone
(aats/backtest/realizable_exit.py: _canonical_realizable_hash); a test FAILS if any hashed
value drifts. Every numeric is a Decimal-as-STRING, never a float (data-models.md §0).
THE MODEL (realizable_exit.py): the OUTCOME fill is worse than the optimistic SPOT mark by
(1) LIQUIDITY IMPACT — slip = min(max_slippage_fraction, linear_impact_coeff * notional_usd /
representative_liquidity_usd), where notional = the sizer's per_trade_cap and representative
liquidity is the THINNEST sellable book in the hold window; and (2) HONEYPOT — a mark that is
unpriced OR whose liquidity_usd is null / below min_liquidity_usd_floor is UNSELLABLE; a
position never sellable in its window recovers only honeypot_residual_bps of notional (a
near-total loss minus fees). REALIZABLE net PnL is ALWAYS <= SPOT net PnL (realism only lowers
PnL); the ~6% round-trip cost stack (build_round_trip_cost_stack) stacks ON TOP of this.
FROZEN — MUST NOT BE TUNED AGAINST THE CORPUS. Changing a value here is p-hacking the OUTCOME
against the scoreboard; it is a TEST FAILURE, not an edit. Open an ADR + delta notice instead.

params_provenance.linear_impact_coeff: First-order (constant-product) price-impact coefficient. slip_fraction = coeff * notional_usd / liquidity_usd (capped). 1.0 = selling a notional equal to X% of pool liquidity costs ~X% slippage — a conservative, defensible first-order impact. Illustrative structural constant, NOT fitted. Decimal-as-string.
params_provenance.max_slippage_fraction: Hard cap on a single realizable exit's slippage fraction (0..1). 0.90 => a SELLABLE exit always keeps at least 10% of spot proceeds; it prevents the linear model from producing an unbounded haircut that would double-count the honeypot branch. Decimal-as-string.
params_provenance.min_liquidity_usd_floor: A forward mark whose liquidity_usd is null OR strictly below this (USD) is UNSELLABLE at decision-relevant size (no real, non-honeypot exit market). 500 = a structural real-market floor for a 0.1-SOL sniper exit; null liquidity is always unsellable. Decimal-as-string.
params_provenance.honeypot_residual_bps: Residual recovery (bps of notional) on a position that is NEVER sellable in its hold window. 0 = a total loss of the notional (minus fees) — the 'near-total loss' the task requires; never assume an exit at a price you could not realize. Integer bps as Decimal-as-string.
params_provenance.sol_usd_fallback: Coarse SOL/USD rate used ONLY when a mark carries no price_usd to derive the true rate from (rate = price_usd / price_sol). The live corpus carries price_usd, so this fallback is rarely used; it is a clearly-labeled coarse default, not a fitted level. Decimal-as-string.

invariant: REALIZABLE net_pnl <= SPOT net_pnl for the same path, always (realism only lowers PnL). Enforced by construction (realizable_gross = spot_gross - non_negative_deduction) + a clamp, and asserted by tests/backtest/test_realizable_exit.py.
